description: The form's object field 'pick…' button enters accept mode for the <product> type — banner shown, acceptable presentations highlighted.
Right-clicking a streaming table's row (a <row> presentation) opens its object menu.
Right-clicking the widget's own title presentation opens its menu (open in tile, inspect, ask the agent).
Rejecting live from Pending: unlike the static Rejected story (which sets danger:false in args), a real decision leaves the card's original danger styling in place — the two can disagree.
